propositions: The loud refusal in _pai_check_config at runner.py:718 raises unconditionally on base_url/api_key configuration, contradicting docs/llm-framework.md which documents OpenAI-compatible endpoints (LMStudio, Ollama) as supported.
Documentation shows REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai combined with REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL should work end-to-end, but config.py parses these values while runner.py refuses them.

A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (non-hosted, non-OpenAI) inherits the hosted OpenAI profile's native_structured_output=True, creating a silent wrong-answer failure mode when the server does not actually support strict json_schema.
The openai SDK is not a runtime dependency (agents extra omits it) so registering an eager builder unconditionally would break existing parameterized tests that stub _pai_structured.
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for non-loopback hosts already routes through a gateway by accident because anthropic_model.py only overrides loopback; this capability should be deliberate and tested.
The builder must stay under 300 LOC (S1 criterion) or live in a separate module, and base_url must not become a provider selector — model_provider remains the authoritative source.
